seoTitle: Waypoint List to GPX: Route, Track or Waypoints
metaDescription: Type latitude, longitude and name per line and download a GPX route, track or waypoints for your GPS or app. Offline, no map clicks.
intro: Writes a GPX 1.1 file from a typed list of points, as a route, a track or plain named waypoints.
why:
Planning a route usually means clicking on a map, which needs map tiles. If you know the points, you can type them and get the GPX file directly, ready for a GPS unit or a hiking app.

Routes are meant to be navigated, tracks record where you went. The tool can also write the same points as named waypoints. It shows the great-circle length between points, which is shorter than any real path. The file was parsed with gpxpy to verify structure.
howTo: Type one point per line: lat, lon, name.
Choose route, track or waypoints only.
Name the route and decide on extra waypoints.

faq.a: No, the line goes straight between your points.
